items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: He didn't have Bill, I mean, at the same time. Because he was playing trombone, he was playing trombone, Willie Connish, Willie Connish, and Lurens of Stahl on guitar. They didn't use but five pieces.

ctx.x: And what was Bill Matthews playing? Trombone or playing drums?

No, no, no, he wasn't playing trombone then. I forgot now what he was playing. But he didn't have, that's right, he didn't have them at the same time. He didn't have Bill, I mean, at the same time. Because he was playing trombone, he was playing trombone, Willie Connish, Willie Connish, and Lurens of Stahl on guitar. They didn't use but five pieces. No piano. No piano. No saxophone. No saxophone. No saxophone. No saxophone. Tuxedo band, the only band used a piano. And they have a piano when they go to a place to…
Now what about in playing trumpet behind the singers? How did that develop?
